title: Travel gear to sleep better
lead: What can help you follow your plan when light or quiet are lacking. None of this equipment is essential.

items.title: Light
text: When your plan calls for bright light early in the morning or late in the evening, a light therapy lamp can replace the sun. Choose a model that meets medical standards, with white light and a UV filter, and follow its instructions for distance and duration.

items.title: Darkness
text: A well-blocking sleep mask helps you sleep in flight and avoid light at the times indicated. Sunglasses are often enough outdoors.

items.title: Noise
text: Foam earplugs or noise-cancelling headphones for nights on the plane and at the hotel.

items.title: Comfort
text: A neck pillow and loose clothing make it easier to sleep on board.
